author: 5kO0
content:
Surfaced by #22's wild-corpus rustc-compile test, against the 420-doc app+chat+com+tools wild slice scraped 2026-05-08.

Concrete instance: com.deckbelcher.richtext defines a struct \`document\` whose lexicon description literally contains a newline:

  \"description\": \"A multi-block rich text document.\\nUsed for primers and other long-form content.\"

The codegen emits it via a single-line `/// {desc}` template (escape_doc_text doesn't add `///` continuation on internal newlines). Result in the generated source:

  /// A multi-block rich text document.
  Used for primers and other long-form content.
  #[derive(...)]
  pub struct Document { ... }

rustc parses the bare second line as code:
  error: expected one of `!` or `::`, found keyword `for`
   --> .../richtext/mod.rs:42:6

Fix shape: when emitting `/// <desc>`, replace internal `\n` with `\n/// `. One-liner change in `escape_doc_text` (proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs, around line 1043) or at every call site that pushes `\"/// {desc}\\n\"`. Easier to fix at the helper since it's a single funnel.

The bundled bsky/atproto corpus apparently doesn't contain any multi-line descriptions, which is why this is the first time it's surfaced — same shape as #23/#24, "the wild corpus exposes patterns the bundled set didn't."
